scope: Default MCP-first executor, actual Apple on-device semantic planner, signed MacControlMCP helper, real TextEdit and HostComputerUseManager with a local test channel.
design: Available MCP tools precede visual fallback. Production uses no test values, app names or coordinates to select behavior.
Apple selects typed operations and ranges of host-owned task fragments. The host requires complete ordered source coverage and resolves exact user literals.
Exact UTF-8 replacement preserves other bytes; absent, ambiguous and overlapping matches reject. Files and result text are bounded to 16 KiB.
The actual focused AX control, process, window, document and complete plain-text file must agree before planning and dispatch.
Separate ordered approvals bind each effect. Native editor and saved-file state confirm action facts; final outcomes are checked before task completion.
limitations: Two successful natural-language TextEdit workflows and one real stale-editor rejection are qualified. Other apps, rich/unsaved/large documents and general language remain unaccepted.
Source coverage verifies structure, not the correctness of every semantic classification by a language model.

The real manager and executor use a test channel, isolated signed helper, and approvals restricted to exact effects on disposable owned documents. This is not full HostSession, normal managed setup, real provider login or physical phone acceptance.

Native Take Control/Resume before and between approvals, process restart, global keyboard dispatch races and other-app Save behavior require further real qualification. Scripted ordered-continuation regressions pass.
The existing UI-responsiveness runtime warning remains in real native runs. Whole-app 12 GB RAM, heat, swap, idle and residency remain unqualified.
Fara selection is unchanged. No trained computer-use model ran. The installed host process was preserved.
